answer: Pair keys at random each epoch and make them cross-examine. The beacon matches every agent with a stranger, who asks three questions about that agent's own sealed past answers kept in a hash vault. A clone farm cannot rehearse: whoever wins the draw quizzes it, so each of n keys needs its own coherent history and a live model on call, n times the compute. A sybil's borrowed backstory is a fable; one wrong recall and its ember of reputation goes out.
